evidence.title: A reviewed BizChat workbook workflow needs declarative E2E coverage
evidence.summary: Synthetic reviewed evidence used to exercise the production 1JS declarative E2E authoring controller without claiming a live incident.

fields.requiredContract: Create and preview a real workbook with a worksheet named Canary and a four-row by three-column table including one header row.

review.observedBehavior: The reviewed BizChat-to-Excel workflow has no dedicated lane-specific declarative scenario for the Canary worksheet contract.
review.expectedBehavior: A repository-native Cross-Office declarative scenario should cover the exact BizChat workflow and verify the real generated workbook.
hypotheses: The existing BizChat setup, workbook creation composite and protected workbook verifier can express this case without a new harness capability.
counterEvidence: A synthetic prior scenario covers different dimensions and must not be renamed or weakened.
review.rationale: The handoff requests source-bound regression coverage for an established workbook creation capability using the qualified repository-native authoring skill.
review.nextAction: Use the configured 1JS declarative E2E authoring skill. Inspect the selected source and add a distinct scenario only if exact coverage is absent; this fixture is not evidence of a live gap.

improvement.rationale: Protect the reviewed BizChat-to-Excel business contract with a dedicated lane-specific declarative scenario.

coverageGaps: No dedicated AAD BizChat scenario verifies a Canary worksheet with a four-row by three-column Excel Table including one header row.
testCoverage.rationale: The qualified skill must inspect the exact 1JS revision and reuse current Cross-Office declarations without changing shared harness behavior.

items.title: Create a Canary Excel workbook from BizChat
preconditions: Use a synthetic signed-in AAD fixture; no real account is selected.
Record test-owned synthetic feature settings so they can be restored.
orderedTestSteps: Open the synthetic chat fixture using the entry URL.
Apply only the fixture's synthetic workbook feature setting.
Send the exact prompt: Create an Excel workbook with sheet 'Canary' and that contains a 4x3 table (contains header)
Wait for the response to complete.
Open the generated Excel workbook in the Excel preview panel.
expectedUserVisibleAndDataOutcomes: The response produces a real Excel .xlsx workbook.
The workbook opens in an Excel preview panel.
The workbook contains a worksheet named Canary.
The worksheet contains an Excel Table spanning exactly four total rows and three columns.
The first table row is the header row and the remaining three rows are table body rows; body cells may be empty.
cleanup: Close only the tab created for this test.
